payload.title: jlanders_capstone_fixed
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook explores oceanographic data to analyze water mass distributions and mixing in the Atlantic Ocean. It uses various scientific libraries to fetch and visualize data, focusing on tracers like phosphate, salinity, and temperature. The notebook applies statistical methods to investigate differences between North Atlantic Deep Water (NADW) and Antarctic Bottom Water (AABW), and employs a two end-member mixing model to study the extent of Southern Ocean source water. Additionally, it uses t-tests to assess connectedness in the Atlantic Ocean.
goals: Analyze oceanographic data for water mass distribution.
Investigate statistical differences between NADW and AABW.
Apply a two end-member mixing model to the Atlantic Ocean.
